title: Battle of Gerchsheim
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Gerchsheim", at revision 1370110827, opens: "The Battle of Gerchsheim was an artillery battle during the Austro-Prussian War as part of the Campaign of the Main on July 25, 1866, between the Prussian Alliance and the German Federal Army." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q15811474, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1866 battle of the Austro-Prussian War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
